name: Kimball Jenkins Summer Art Camp
description_short: Art day camp at Kimball Jenkins in Concord, run in two week themed sessions. Campers aged 6 to 14 take three art classes a day with Kimball Jenkins faculty, grouped by age, and show their work in the historic mansion on the last Friday.
refund_policy_summary: Cancellations 30 or more days before a session get a full refund less a $50 fee. Later cancellations are refunded only if the spot is filled from the waitlist, with case by case review for serious illness or family emergency. Families can instead donate the tuition or take a credit for another youth program.

sessions.name: Session C: Fantasy Fairytales and Mystical Creatures (2 weeks)

sources.note: Researched by Claude from this page; 2026 Parent Handbook: camp 9 to 2:30, extended day 8 to 8:30 and 2:30 to 5:30 for $50 a week; two week session $700 early bird (March 2 to April 30) or $725 from May 1, with $25 off each session when booking several; session prices use the regular $725 rate; lunch brought from home; tuition assistance by application; all classes indoors on the Kimball Jenkins campus
